core_obligations: Use properness and the dominance hypothesis to rule out components supported entirely on the special fibre.
Conclude reducedness of the total space, and hence of the generic fibre, from the reducedness of the special fibre.

proof_roadmap.step: Analyse the components of the total space over the valuation ring.
Use properness and dominance to control them.
Conclude reducedness of the total space and the generic fibre.

difficulty_reason: For a proper morphism to the spectrum of a discrete valuation ring, assuming every irreducible component of the total space dominates the base and the special fibre is reduced, the lemma proves that both the total space and the generic fibre are reduced. The proof uses properness and the dominance hypothesis to control the components, compares the special fibre with the total space through the local structure over the valuation ring, and concludes reducedness of the total space and hence of the generic fibre by restriction. Using properness to prevent components from being supported on the special fibre is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 7313-7339.
